title: MemoFlow system-wide vNext execution graph
objective: Complete the remaining Phase 4-7 system-wide vNext convergence as one coherent destructive cutover: Routine, Planner/Scheduler and Notification become canonical owner models; Home/Dashboard and AI align to those owners; Data Portability becomes V3-only; legacy schema is deleted; final whole-system review and exact-head validation close PR #340 without restoring compatibility models.
architecture_decisions: Each product fact has one authoritative owner; read models may compose owners but must not become write authorities.
ADR-111 zero-legacy-data policy applies: coordinated cutovers delete retired models directly rather than adding row converters or permanent compatibility layers.
TaskGraph is planning truth and ForgeFlow threads are execution truth; workers do not write live execution status back into this graph or the system-wide plan.
Prisma and PowerSync canonical schema parity must land in the same coherent destructive batch when persistence changes.
SchedulingPort/reconcile, lease/fencing/idempotency/restart recovery, Product Time, stable KnowledgeDocumentId, Goal vNext and Task vNext are protected foundations.
Parallel execution is bounded by semantic mutation ownership; generated test inventory conflicts are reconciled at integration and are not separate domain ownership.
protected_contracts: Do not resurrect ReminderTemplate/Group/Instance/Response, ScheduleTask/config/source-module, Notification template/channel aggregate truth, Dashboard domain truth, or AI legacy persistence after their cutover tasks retire them.
Routine remains the owner of Routine definition/profile/runtime/occurrence/intervention semantics; Scheduler never becomes the Routine owner.
Scheduler preserves SchedulingPort/reconcile plus durable invocation claim, retry, fencing, idempotency and restart behavior while changing its persistence model.
Notification Fact/Inbox is distinct from delivery execution truth; delivery attempts/outbox/receipts do not become root Fact status.
Product Time is the only timezone/locale/week-start authority; no host-local Date fallback may be introduced.
Goal, Task, Label, Account/Setting and Knowledge owner contracts that already passed exact-head closure remain stable unless a task explicitly consumes them without changing ownership.
Every accepted task requires focused verification plus repository-required exact-head CI and independent review before it is considered dependency-complete.
non_goals: Do not preserve old production data; rollback is source/deployment rollback plus reset/reseed.
Do not invent new generic analytics, settings, workflow or repository domains to avoid deleting legacy models.
Do not combine unrelated cosmetic refactors, dependency upgrades or formatting sweeps with convergence tasks.
Do not enable ForgeFlow AI decomposition; ChatGPT Web remains the planner for this graph.
acceptance_criteria: Every task is accepted on an exact reviewed head and integrated onto feat/system-wide-vnext-convergence.
All Phase 4 owner cutovers are complete before Phase 5 owner consumers are considered stable.
Portable V3 covers every surviving portable product fact before V2 deletion.
The whole-schema legacy sweep leaves no unowned legacy persistence or public compatibility surface except explicitly documented permanent governance state.
Final repository-wide docs, governance, typecheck, lint, test, build, affected integration/E2E, Prisma/PowerSync parity, local product journeys and AI eval replay are green before archive.
